q1-config-threading.title: How does emit_fusion_train_rows thread config->runner->writer; where would emit_module_record live and thread?
q1-config-threading.imperative: Explore the code: gold_cycle/config.py validation (are all [runtime] keys required?), runner.py threading, whether existing configs must all gain the new key. Settle flag home ([runtime] vs GoldCycleDataConfig per issue text) and bool-vs-mode shape.
q1-config-threading.finding: Home: GoldCycleRuntimeConfig [runtime], optional bool via runtime_raw.get('emit_module_record', False) — utilization precedent means NO config-file churn, existing TOMLs stay valid. Thread like emit_fusion_train_rows. Do NOT add to build_run_config/details.json echo (keeps flag-off byte-identity vs pre-change baseline, zero report-schema churn); provenance lives in the .record.json sidecar. Add 'emit_module_record':'runtime' to override-section mapping (utilization precedent). Add explicit false to gold_defaults.toml for discoverability (harmless since not echoed).

q2-writer-seam.title: Where is the per-module backtest JSON written; which call sites would emit records (mains, LOSO, calibration, evidence-mode)?
q2-writer-seam.imperative: Trace run.py backtest command and gold_cycle runner/runner_support call sites of evaluate_labeled_batches; identify the writer that owns backtests/{module}.json and which paths the record spill would attach to.
q2-writer-seam.finding: Single writer: cmd_module_backtest (run.py ~380-446) calls evaluate_labeled_batches then _write_json(args.output). Three template builders feed it: mains (runner.py:143 backtests/{module}.json), LOSO (runner_support.py:773 loso_folds/heldout_{y}/backtests/{module}.json — only runs when emit_fusion_train_rows=leave_one_season_out), calibration (runner_support.py:663 uncertainty_calibration_fit/backtests/{module}_{year}.json). Evidence-mode evals (runner_support.py:266,325) call evaluate_labeled_batches directly, write no backtest file — untouched by default-off param. Seam: opt-in collect param on evaluate_labeled_batches + spill in cmd_module_backtest next to args.output; thread via Namespace templates + CLI flag --emit-module-record for standalone use. EDGE: [reuse] early-return (run.py:395-398) skips emission if output exists — when flag on, reuse must also require record sidecars present, else silent absence.

q3-schema-validation.title: Does gold report schema validation reject unknown sidecar files; what schema docs must move with the new artifact?
q3-schema-validation.imperative: Check src/evo_predictor/gold_report_schema.py and docs (docs/report_schemas/, docs/evo/gold_module_training_cycle_report_schema.md) for whether a new .record.npz/.record.json sidecar breaks validation and what documentation the evidence rules require in the same gate.
q3-schema-validation.finding: No docs/report_schemas/ dir exists; schema docs live in docs/evo/ generated from gold_report_schema.py. Its undocumented_paths() validates details/summary JSON payload content, NOT directory file listings — .record.* sidecars are invisible to it; nothing dir-scans backtests/. Backtest JSONs + record sidecars are non-committed run artifacts (per run_config.output_dir field note), so the committed-report-schema atomic rule does not bind. Doc duty still applies: document the record contract (new docs/evo/ page or section) in the same gate; records stay out of git per artifact policy.

q4-determinism.title: How is byte-identical output verified today; do details.json/backtest JSON embed timestamps or run ids?
q4-determinism.imperative: Check tests/integration/test_utilization_determinism.py and the report writers for timestamp/run-id fields to determine how acceptance criterion 1 (flag off => byte-identical) can actually be verified.
q4-determinism.finding: Post-G4 fix, fixed-threads same-seed training is bit-reproducible (test_utilization_determinism.py). Volatile fields exist: manifest created_at + absolute paths; backtest JSON embeds bundle_manifest_path. Cross-RUN byte-identity needs normalization, BUT the strongest cheap check avoids it: train one bounded bundle once, run cmd_module_backtest twice on the same bundle (flag off vs on) — backtest JSON byte-identical (inference deterministic), .record.* files appear only flag-on. data/f1_data_*.db (~7MB/yr) and params/retro_truth ARE committed, so worktree integration tests run with real data (bounded pattern: 2 modules, 2 years, max_rounds 1, 2 epochs, threads 1 — minutes). Unit-level: synthetic batches assert default evaluate_labeled_batches rows unchanged; round-trip via np.array_equal.

q5-coverage.title: USER: record emission coverage — mains + LOSO only, or also calibration backtests?
q5-coverage.imperative: Ask the user one question with a recommendation, informed by q2 findings.
q5-coverage.finding: USER DECIDED: All module backtests — uniform contract, flag on => every cmd_module_backtest invocation emits records (mains + LOSO + calibration).

q6-verification-scale.title: USER: what scale of gold-cycle run is acceptable evidence for acceptance criteria 1-2?
q6-verification-scale.imperative: Ask the user one question with a recommendation, informed by q4 findings (smoke config vs full run; unit tests).
q6-verification-scale.finding: USER DECIDED (prior session, captured in PROBLEM_STATEMENT decision 6): three tiers — unit tests on synthetic batches (default rows unchanged, exact np.array_equal round-trip); one bounded real-data integration test (determinism mold, backtest twice off/on same bundle => byte-identical JSON, records only flag-on); PLUS one flag-on smoke-mode gold cycle end-to-end with evidence artifact listing records across mains+LOSO+calibration dirs.

q7-harness-scope.title: USER: offline harness — follow-up issue or in this run?
q7-harness-scope.imperative: Ask the user one question with a recommendation (issue text says harness can be a follow-up; this issue must make it possible).
q7-harness-scope.finding: USER DECIDED (prior session, captured in PROBLEM_STATEMENT confirmed ask): offline harness OUT of scope — an issue for it already exists; do not file another. This issue only makes the harness possible via the record emit.

consolidation.summary: Interrogation complete: flag home GoldCycleRuntimeConfig [runtime] optional bool not echoed to details.json; single writer seam cmd_module_backtest + opt-in collect param on evaluate_labeled_batches; sidecars invisible to gold_report_schema; determinism strategy = same-bundle off/on double backtest; USER: uniform coverage (mains+LOSO+calibration), three-tier verification, harness out of scope.
